name: @hotelclaw/memory
description: Property memory — the eve-native replacement for the gbrain server. ONE implementation of the memory store (Supabase Postgres: agent_memories + search_agent_memories RPC), the model-facing tool contracts (remember / forget / search), recall formatting, and the MEMORY_DISCIPLINE standing rules. Shared by apps/web (Tier-1 bots, guest profile side-channel, deterministic capture writers, the Memory browser) and apps/agent (the eve memory provider behind agent/memory/*). Ships TS source: apps/web transpiles via next.config transpilePackages, eve's bundler handles it natively. Keep it dependency-free apart from zod (node builtins allowed); NO react, NO server-only, NO supabase import — callers pass their own client.
